---
name: Feature request
about: Propose new behavior or a change to existing behavior
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What are you proposing?**
A clear description of the new behavior or change.

**Why is this needed?**
What problem does this solve, or what value does it add? (See
`CONTRIBUTING.md` — spec changes come before implementation, so this is
the part that matters most for discussion.)

**How does this fit with the existing spec?**
Does this extend `specs/001-ircv3-server/spec.md`, or does it conflict
with an existing decision recorded there (including the Clarifications
log)? If it conflicts, say what would need to change.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't propose them
instead.

**Additional context**
Anything else relevant — links, prior art in other IRC servers, etc.
